'''Cruisemissile assault craft''', also known as '''cruisemissiles''', were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighters used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
The Cruisemissile assault craft had two proton torpedo launchers and two laser cannons attached to its two thruster engines. The fighter had wings that unfolded upon entering a battlefield, which aided in maneuverability. The fighter lacked armor and shields.<ref name="Kenner" />

==History==
The Cruisemissile was the spearhead of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], launching from [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] to hit [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] military bases.The tiny craft was piloted by [[Cruisemissile trooper]]s, troops picked from elite [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Kenner" />
